annotations.title: Find the same product under another model number

description: Finds other model numbers a verified product is sold under (same specs, different region, retailer or color), with the source for each model number.

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

product.description: Required. The product to look up: slug, model number, another model number, or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). Example: "35527" or "PB771".

name: find_same_product
title: Find the same product under another model number
